Shah Rukh Khan's 'King' Releases First Song Featuring Deepika Padukone

The first song from Shah Rukh Khan's upcoming film 'King', titled 'Tu Mil Jaye', was released on November 25th, coinciding with the actor's 61st birthday. The song features Khan alongside Deepika Padukone, with music by Arijit Singh and Ed Sheeran. The film's foreign rights have reportedly been sold for crores. Some reviews noted a lack of novelty in the chemistry between Khan and Padukone in the song.
